parsed.rationale: The QRS is narrow with very tall R waves in I and aVL (left axis) and very deep S waves in V1-V3, which gives voltage criteria for LVH. Lateral strain-type ST depression and T inversion are present in I and aVL. The ST elevation in V1-V3 is discordant to the deep S waves, which is the usual LVH pattern, so it does not indicate STEMI.
